title: Inspection Failure Theme Rank
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:photo failure_theme=*
| stats count as inspection_failures by failure_theme
| sort - inspection_failures
description: Ranks failure theme by inspection failures volume for inspection findings.
value: Volume rankings show which failure theme are producing the most activity, demand, or friction inside inspection findings.
implementation: Capture each inspection failures as a `reno:photo` event and normalize `failure_theme` so the totals are comparable.
visualization: Bar chart of inspection failures volume by failure theme.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which failure theme show up the most in inspection findings so you know where the busiest areas are.
